The Collection Conference 2026

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:09
Instaread
Date 19 November 2026
Location NAEC Stoneleigh, Kenilworth CV8 2LZ

Contact Maria Foley

E-mail conferences@roarb2b.com

Phone +44 20 4634 2865

VISIT WEBSITE & SECURE YOUR TICKET

The Collection Conference returns in 2026, bringing together local authorities, waste contractors, policy teams and technology providers for a focused, one‑day programme on the future of municipal waste and recycling collections. As major service reforms continue to roll out across the UK, the conference provides clarity, practical guidance and sector‑wide insight at a crucial moment for collection services.

Why attend / What the 2026 programme will cover:

  • Policy and regulatory developments shaping household and business waste collections
  • Simpler Recycling preparation, including service design, procurement and communications
  • Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) impacts on funding, contracts and operational planning
  • Digital waste tracking guidance, data requirements and implications for local authorities
  • Collection trial findings, including flexible plastics, cartons and food waste in flats
  • Operational case studies showcasing practical solutions and lessons from UK authorities
  • Technology and fleet innovation, from route optimisation to in‑cab systems and electrification
  • Peer learning and networking with councils, contractors and system suppliers

Designed for anyone responsible for planning, delivering or improving collection services, the conference offers a chance to review evidence, compare approaches and prepare for upcoming changes across the sector.
